name: Kirin no Yuda
source:
Earth Age: 24 years old.
Special Trait: The two circlets on his forehead
Element: Light
Abilities: Can control space-time
Special Skill: His lips have a healing power

He's noble, strong, and thoughtful.
He has cool looks but inside he is very passionate and has a deep affection for his comrades.
